def _predict(block, x, maps, dt, times, taus, weights):
    hist, hold = _stress(block, maps)
    cov = np.column_stack((np.ones(len(x)), x))
    design, onset = _design(taus, hist, hold, cov, dt, times, block['initial_memory_states'])
    missing = ~np.isfinite(block['coupon_features_raw']).all(axis=1)
    rate_obs = np.asarray(block['instant_rate_obs'])
    # Coupon covariates change the linear drift but not the two relaxation modes.
    drift_correction = np.where(missing & np.isfinite(rate_obs), rate_obs - onset @ weights, 0.)
    curve = block['strain_0'][:, None] + design @ weights + drift_correction[:, None] * times
    return curve, hold


def _crossings(curve, threshold, times):
    hit = curve >= threshold[:, None]
    return np.where(hit.any(axis=1), times[hit.argmax(axis=1)], times[-1])


def solve_alpha_w01_batch_01(dataset: dict) -> dict:
    train, test = dataset['train'], dataset['test']
    dt, times = np.asarray(dataset['past_dt']), np.asarray(dataset['eval_times'])
    maps = _load_cells(dataset['calibration_load_cells'])
    x, xt = _alignment(train, test)
    complete = np.isfinite(train['coupon_features_raw']).all(axis=1)
    if complete.sum() >= 12:
        train = {key: np.asarray(value)[complete] for key, value in train.items()}
        x = x[complete]
    taus, weights = _fit(train, x, maps, dt, times)
    curve, hold = _predict(test, xt, maps, dt, times, taus, weights)
    return {'estimated_taus': taus, 'predicted_strain': curve,
            'secant_compliance': (curve[:, -1] - test['strain_0']) / np.maximum(np.abs(hold), .5),
            'hazard_crossing_times': _crossings(curve, test['critical_strain'], times)}
